headline: 318 customers got two orders for one payment
cause: Your server answered a webhook slowly, so Razorpay sent it again and a second order was made

answer.title: Your server is making two orders for one payment
answer.text: Since server release 3.14 went live at 6:05 pm, your server takes too long to answer Razorpay's webhook. Razorpay sends it again, and each retry makes another order. The customer was charged once.

compared: Compared with your payments in the same hours the day before
cannot_see: orders your server made without a Razorpay payment, such as cash on delivery

root.cause: Your server answered Razorpay's webhook after more than 5 seconds. Razorpay sent it again, and the server made a second order for the same payment.
root.fix: Answer the webhook straight away, and ignore a payment ID that already has an order. Cancel the duplicate orders.
signals: every one came after server release 3.14

actions.title: Send your order team 318 duplicate orders
actions.text: The list has payment IDs, order IDs and times: 222 are not packed yet and can be cancelled, 96 are packed already and have to be stopped before dispatch.

actions.title: Message 318 customers
actions.text: Tells them they were charged once, a second order was made by mistake and is being cancelled. In your name. It waits until your order team has the list.

closing: The cause was your server, not Razorpay: a webhook is sent again by design when it is not answered in time. Every action is approved. In this demo nothing was cancelled or sent.

rca.title: Root cause: your server is making two orders for one payment
lines: Whose side: your server code. Confidence: exact, 3 signals agree.

Affected: 318 customers charged once and given two orders.

rca.signed_off: Signed off by Razorpay support at 6:31 pm
